reviewed.note: c2 exact-fit review passed: the concept is the native SysML verification-case construct itself. The pinned standard library defines VerificationCases::VerificationCase as the most general class of performances of VerificationCaseDefinitions and VerificationCases::verificationCases as the base feature of all VerificationCaseUsages. The ontology description (a planned or executed check that evaluates whether a requirement or model claim is satisfied) states that specification/performance scope and the check-for-satisfaction purpose without asserting any outcome, so it is a bounded description of the native construct for DE4SDV usage; the DE4SDV verify targets are requirement usages (evidence contracts and acceptance criteria). Standard-library grounding proven for the real DE4SDV constructs (Lane B): the definition VC-AEBS-009D-DE (ConsciousOverrideVerification) carries a toolchain-materialized implied Subclassification to VerificationCases::VerificationCase and each usage VC-AEBS-009D-01..06 an implied Subsetting to VerificationCases::verificationCases; the anchors were resolved by the licensed exporter from the pinned Systems Library/VerificationCases.sysml and cross-checked in the imported closure. The API metaclass (VerificationCaseDefinition / VerificationCaseUsage) is a separate evidence field from the library grounding (UG-28): the metaclass alone is not the semantic proof. Grounding provenance: the library edges are toolchain-implied and stay visibly implied; the DE4SDV usage-to-definition typing is explicitly authored; no redundant authorship was added for the implied grounding. Claim boundary: verification-objective carrier only; no execution, outcome, evidence-maturity, or release implication. The retained Lane B exact-toolchain evidence stays supporting evidence only (not revision-bound to this inventory revision, so the evidence state stops at parity-reviewed): privileged run 34576049742 (success) at candidate 0a23902370de9fc74d6118afe480382e0b0d8aa0; artifact full-model-api-ingestion-0a23902370de9fc74d6118afe480382e0b0d8aa0.
required_evidence: O2 generated projection row from the reviewed native representation
revision-bound exact-toolchain evidence before any stronger evidence state is claimed
reviewed.exact_fit_decision: exact fit: SysML v2 verification case is a native construct (the standard library base class VerificationCases::VerificationCase and base feature VerificationCases::verificationCases); DE4SDV adds no competing semantics and introduces no parallel application class where the native construct is exact. The definition/usage distinction is carried by the native constructs themselves, and the reviewed description neither strengthens nor weakens the standard semantics. Claim boundary: declared verification coverage only — the class itself does not assert that any check ran, produced a result, or reached an outcome.

current_ontology_row.definition: Explicit binding from a composite member product's contained architecture instances (its logical-system and software usages) to the canonical architecture usages whose allocation and evidence records govern them. The modeled dependencies originate from the contained usages, not from the member-product root; the executable mapping must therefore define which elements carry this relationship and how a query walks it before any product-level query reachability is claimed. Vocabulary only for now: no sysml_mapping is declared because a generic dependency traversal cannot distinguish canonical-architecture bindings from ordinary part-to-part dependencies without inventing a naming heuristic. Declaring an executable mapping requires an explicit canonical-usage selector (for example an API-side allowlist of canonical packages), not a name-based filter. The binding does not restate allocations at product level and does not make a composite projection a resolved configured product.
